one_line_summary: Section IV.A synthetic demo largely reproduced: SRCP–XGBoost adaptivity and MCD/GP flatness confirmed; BNN and DE adaptivity weaker than reported; SAFARI-1 case study not reproduced.

claim_by_claim.claim: C1 Split-CP + DNN produces a constant uncertainty band across x
C2 SRCP + XGBoost shows good agreement with the analytical solution — local-adaptive
C3 MC Dropout similar to split CP with rather constant value across the whole domain
C4 BNN covers more data points than MCD and exhibits slight local adaptivity
C5 Deep Ensemble shows impressive local adaptivity comparable to SRCP with XGBoost
C6 GP with wrong kernel similar to split CP with a constant uncertainty

caveats: Only Section IV.A (analytical GP synthetic demo) was reproduced; the SAFARI-1 real-reactor case study (Section IV.B) was not reproduced due to non-public data.
BNN implementation used Pyro/SVI with 3×10 hidden units; differences from the authors’ setup may affect adaptivity and calibration.
Deep Ensemble configuration (10 members, NLL) and training details may differ from the authors’, potentially explaining weaker adaptivity (low width–σ correlation).

Evaluation emphasizes quantitative metrics (coverage, width–σ correlation, width range ratio) rather than purely qualitative plots; thresholds for ‘adaptivity’ may differ from the paper’s qualitative assessment.
Results are from a single dataset seed (20260702); stochastic variability could affect adaptivity metrics across runs.
Nominal 95% coverage was approximately met across methods (0.92–0.99), but small deviations from exact 0.95 were observed.
